owners.runtime: Session supplies the same WidgetRuntimeState used by actual native widget owners. owners.field_migration: Move live prefix name,geometry,resize-known-bits and dynamic property names/typed values into the WidgetState component; no second mutable state in NativeSetupPrefixState. The prefix retains stage/issue/ordered effects/qualification/event ownership. Existing diagnostic consumers use const accessors/view into same live component; historical snapshots may copy values only when explicitly marked immutable and never dispatched.

StagedEditor300::continueNativeSetupPropertyNotification(Editor300Binding) -> NativeSetupPrefixReport uses existing bound setup/component/runtime and actual pending event. No external success boolean or independent copied application context.
